# InnovaWise Labs

> InnovaWise Labs designs and installs practical AI-powered workflows for service businesses: missed-call recovery, lead and quote follow-up, invoice reminders, customer response, and the manual admin work that is currently slowing teams down.

InnovaWise Labs is built on the AxentraWise Framework, which unifies workflow automation, infrastructure, security, and operational reporting into one connected system instead of disconnected point tools. Every engagement begins with a free 90-minute AI Profit Leak Audit. Basic automations (single workflow, single integration) typically go live in 5 to 7 days; larger framework deployments (multi-workflow, multi-integration) run 6 to 12 weeks depending on scope, with one architect accountable for the outcome end to end.

## Company

- Founded by: Jason Knapp, Co-Founder and Lead Systems Architect, architect of the AxentraWise Framework
- Website: https://innovawiselabs.com
- Phone: (480) 420-8833
- Positioning: Systems architects for service businesses, not tool vendors. Vendor-agnostic, no long-term lock-in, clients own what is built.

## Services

- Workflow Automation: missed-call recovery and lead intake, quote and follow-up automation, invoice and payment reminder workflows, document processing and data extraction, CRM and communication platform integrations. See: /services.html
- Cloud Infrastructure and Systems Architecture: cloud and hybrid infrastructure design, system and platform integrations, deployment pipeline automation, infrastructure as code, backup and recovery planning. See: /services.html
- Security and Compliance Readiness: zero-trust network architecture, identity and access management (IAM), user access and offboarding workflows, vendor and policy management, and SOC 2 / HIPAA / PCI DSS readiness support. This means secure automation implementation, evidence collection automation, policy acknowledgement tracking, audit and assessment request tracking, compliance dashboards, security-questionnaire support, and documentation and readiness project management. It does not include SOC monitoring, threat hunting, penetration testing, digital forensics, incident response, formal audits, attestations, certifications, or compliance guarantees. See: /security.html
- AxentraWise Framework Deployment: full-stack integration of workflow automation, infrastructure, security, and operational reporting into one connected operating system, with modular implementation by priority and ongoing optimization. See: /axentrawise.html

## Problems We Solve

These are the operational leaks the AI Profit Leak Audit looks for in a service business. They are the problems the work addresses, not claims about past results.

- Missed calls that never get followed up, so the job goes to whoever answered first
- Slow speed to lead, where an inquiry sits for hours or days before anyone responds
- Quotes that go out and are never chased
- Invoices that age because nobody has time to send reminders
- Repetitive admin work that consumes owner and office-manager hours
- Scheduling churn and rework from manual dispatch
- The owner becoming the bottleneck because critical steps live only in their head

## Client Results

InnovaWise Labs is an early-stage firm. We do not publish case studies we cannot substantiate, and we will not attribute outcomes to clients who have not agreed to be named and measured. Published case studies with real, verifiable numbers are in progress. See: /case-studies.html

If you want to judge the quality of the work before committing, the AI Profit Leak Audit is free and you keep the findings whether or not you hire us.
